none: PAS CAM-C89735: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantine II, AD 317-340
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLOR-[...] ; D/ [...]NVS IVN N C

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantine II, AD 317-340 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLOR-[...]. Reverse shows two soldiers, two standards. Mint is uncertain, c. AD 330-335. Obverse legend reads [...]NVS IVN N C. Obverse shows a bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 0.85g, diameter is 13.4mm, thickness is 1.2mm
